item.title: Asahi Linux on M3
item.description:
📝 In other words, Asahi Linux now officially supports Macs with an M3 series SoC. Linux support for M3 series SoCs and the machines powered by them is now in a state where almost everything supported on the M1 and M2 series machines just works. Support for M3 is the culmination of years of hard work from multiple people, many of whom have only been able to access M3 hardware because of your support.
🔗 Read more: https://asahilinux.org/2026/09/m2-episode-1/
